verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU Omulokozi
Yanfiirira ku muti,
N'anzigyako ebibi:
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Gunsinze,so sirina:
Butuukirivu bwonna:
Naye ggwe wanfiirira:
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Obutukuvu bwange,
Bwonna nziina njereere;
Kyennaavanga nkweisga,
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ebibi byansonyiyibwa,
N'ebbanja lyange lyaggwa;
Lwe nakukkiriza ggwe:
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ombeerenga bulijjo,
Ntabule mu kkubo lyo;
Nkwatenga-amateeka go.
Yesu Mulokozi wange!
